provisionalBeforeNote: Miffy Mouse was provisional from prompt #14 to prompt #16; its P1-P3 are in the history of audio/dev/ before prompt #16.

processing.$comment: Ping's sound: what ElevenLabs returns (audio/raw/) goes through this once (npm run audio:process) into audio/dev/. Chain chosen by Claude in prompt #15 (round2.processed stronger), chosen by the author in prompt #16; gain rule and codec from prompt #16; peakCeiling chosen by Claude.
processing.gainRule: one gain for the whole file that brings the processed RMS back to the raw file's RMS, lowered if any sample would go above peakCeiling
processing.peakCeilingWhy: Chosen: 5 % below full scale before the mp3 encode, so the encoder's overshoot does not clip; the decoded result's peak is logged.
processing.encodeWhy: Chosen: the same codec, bit rate and sample rate as ElevenLabs' mp3_44100_128; one encode, from floats, never mp3 to mp3

metadataApprovedBy: the author's rule in prompt #16 (approved if the dump shows the encoder tag only), applied with npm run audio:metadata: each file's <name>.metadata.txt says "encoder tag only: yes"
settingsWhy: Chosen: a stable, unstylised reading so the mouth tests are about the method, not about a dramatic take.
seedWhy: Chosen: ElevenLabs takes a seed for repeatable sampling on a best-effort basis; whether it repeats is measured (P1 twice).

phrases.P2: My mouth moves when the sound gets loud.
phrases.P3: Oh wow. We move, you see?

design.description: A small, friendly character who lives inside a computer terminal. An adult voice, gender-neutral, mid-range pitch. Curious and quick, with a light, slightly dry sense of humour. Clear, precise diction and a brisk, even pace. Not a child, not a cartoon mouse, not robotic.

An adult, gender-neutral voice for a tiny program in a terminal that has become self-aware: bright and curious, a little deadpan, with crisp consonants and a clean, slightly synthetic timbre that stays warm underneath. Moderate, quick pace. Not childlike, not squeaky, not a monotone robot.

processed.why: chosen: a slightly narrowed band, a faint bit-crush and a very short echo, like a small speaker; words untouched
chosen: a telephone-like band, more bit-crush, a light metallic comb; still above 5 kHz cut-offs that keep consonants clear

frozen: Since the author's prompt #17 the voice settings (chosen, modelId, settings, outputFormat, seed) and processing (chain, gainRule, peakCeiling, encode) do not change: rig/frozen.json, test/freeze.test.mjs.
metadataApprovedHeldOut: H1-H4: approved by Claude applying the author's prompt #16 rule (encoder tag only) to the held-out files of prompt #17, which did not restate it; each <name>.metadata.txt says "encoder tag only: yes". The author may take them out.
